description.en: Separate source-only Range materialization evidence; preserves the stage1 Range checkpoint and historical canonical audit.
description.ko: 1단계 Range 체크포인트와 기존 정식 API 감사는 보존하고 구체화 보조 함수의 소스 검증을 별도로 기록한다.

collect_vector.signature: Result<Vector<T>, CollectionError> collect_vector<T>(Range<T> descriptor) where T implements Copy
collect_vector.reserve_failure_mapping: Vector.reserve propagates Core CollectionError AllocationFailure/SizeOverflow unchanged.
collect_vector.byte_limit: Vector.reserve checks count <= INT64_MAX / sizeof(T) before malloc, starting from an empty owner.
collect_vector.allocation_cost: One explicit reserve prepares capacity. Vector.push retains its ordinary per-element capacity checks; exactly one output-buffer allocation occurs for a successful nonempty result. Empty output does not allocate.
collect_vector.ownership: The Copy Range descriptor remains usable. A failed Result exposes no partial Vector; owned output storage is cleaned by ordinary ownership rules.

to_array.signature: Result<Array<T,N>, RangeArrayError> to_array<const usize N, T>(Range<T> descriptor) where T implements Copy
to_array.type_argument_inference: N is explicit first const argument; T is inferred from the Range.
to_array.nominal_carrier_difference: range.RangeArrayError is distinct from canonical RangeError, which is unchanged.
to_array.validation: Exact cardinality is checked before explicit [zero; N] construction and cursor copying. Array/Result target layouts are checked at compile time.
to_array.array_repeat_copy_rule: Repeated array elements must implement Copy, including zero-length repeats. No implicit clone.
to_array.abi_limit: The current aggregate Result ABI still reserves, zero-initializes and copies O(N) storage even on an error. Mismatch avoids the explicit ArrayRepeat loop, not all O(N) work. No C++ optimization is included.
to_array.stack_boundary: Static target-layout representability is checked. Available stack headroom is not predicted or proven.

CountOverflow.message: The range cardinality cannot be represented by usize.

LengthMismatch.message: The range cardinality differs from the fixed array extent.

executed_compiler.original_bundle: A copied historical compiler and its original bundled providers were used for the standalone prototype.
executed_compiler.candidate_bundle: A second copy changes only share/aevix/library/Collections/range.avx to the candidate source, preserving the original prototype snapshot.

standalone_prototype_gate.boundary: Historical standalone materialize.* provider, preceding the packaged range.* name binding.

independent_oracle.method: Python range/list construction and direct literal comparisons; implementation rank/span helpers are not imported.
independent_oracle.checks: Each expected sequence is compared to both the Vector and fixed Array; original descriptors and mismatch expected/actual payloads are also checked.
independent_oracle.count_boundaries: Full-domain 64/128-bit ranges return overflow errors without allocation.

native_observers.seam: Only generated LLVM malloc/free names or the explicit ArrayRepeat element-store are redirected; original IR is retained. Runtime and harness allocations are not redirected. This is controlled allocator substitution, not process-wide tracing.
native_observers.allocation_modes: For 12 element types, success plus each of 12 fail positions plus fail-all: exact byte size, one preallocation, no remaining output buffers.
native_observers.zero_allocation_cases: Empty Vector, cardinality overflow, byte-size overflow, fixed-array success and mismatch across all 12 types.
native_observers.byte_boundary: For 64/128/native-width types, exact INT64_MAX/element-size is accepted with exact byte count and controlled OOM; threshold+1 is rejected with zero allocation attempts. No huge physical allocation is attempted.
native_observers.array_initialization: A 4096-element match performs 4096 explicit ArrayRepeat stores; mismatch performs zero explicit ArrayRepeat stores at O0/O2. Result ABI zero-initialization remains unchanged.
